title: Log in to MCeLE with CAC or username and password
content:
MCeLE supports CAC login and username/password login. Some MCeLE content and features require CAC access because of distribution and security settings.

### Before you begin

Have your CAC and PIN ready for CAC login, or have your MCeLE username and password ready for username/password login. Limit failed attempts to avoid a mandatory lockout period.

### CAC login

1. Close all open browser sessions.
2. Open a new browser.
3. Insert your CAC into the card reader.
4. Navigate to the MCeLE URL.
5. When the Warning Statement appears, select **Agree**.
6. Choose your DoD ID Certificate and select **OK**.
7. Enter your PIN, then select **OK**.
8. Confirm that the MCeLE Portal Student Landing Page displays.

Your CAC must be associated with your MCeLE account before it can be used to log in.

### Username/password login

1. Close all open browser sessions.
2. Open a new browser.
3. Navigate to the MCeLE URL.
4. When the Warning Statement appears, select **Agree**.
5. If prompted to select a CAC or certificate, select **Cancel**.
6. On the MCeLE Login page, enter your username and password, then select **Login**.
7. Confirm that the MCeLE Portal Landing Page displays.

If you do not remember your credentials, use the approved credential-recovery guidance for **Forgot Username?** or **Forgot Password?**.

### Common account notes

If your account is locked, use the account-unlock process. If your account is disabled because of inactivity, contact the Help Desk for account reactivation. Your profile must be verified every six months; after login, the Profile page opens automatically for review and updates. If your password has expired, use the password-change process.

### CAC login problem

If CAC login fails, remove the CAC, close every tab and browser, reinsert the CAC, and try again. On a personal device, install the required DoD root certificates from [Cyber.mil PKI/PKE end-user guidance](https://www.cyber.mil/pki-pke/end-users/getting-started/). A new CAC may require clearing the browser's current certificate and restarting the browser. Contact the Help Desk if the account is deactivated or disabled.

### Username/password login problem

For an **invalid credentials** message, use **Forgot Password?**, restart the browser, and try again. If repeated attempts locked the account, wait or contact the Help Desk for a manual unlock. Check the username format, typically `firstname.middleinitial.lastname`, or use **Forgot Username?**. When recovering a username, try both your personal and work email if needed.

### Disabled account

If your account is disabled because of inactivity, contact the Help Desk for account reactivation.
